name: lr_fhss
description: LR-FHSS simulation model test vectors for the LICHEN simulator. Airtime is 2x standard LoRa airtime per Semtech AN1200.64. Sensitivity is -137.0 dBm (SX1262 LR-FHSS mode at CR=5/9, OCW=4). Fragment collision model: LR-FHSS recovers from up to 4 overlapping standard LoRa interferers via FEC; 5+ interferers causes total loss.
